boundaries.raw_artifacts: Local external cache only; full activations, audio, model files and binaries are not committed. Cache retention is not remote durability.

claim.scope: Four full same-code original Fish DAC controls and three-way GPU comparisons executed. Original decoder substitution retains the measured quiet continuation; unique silence cause and strict native parity remain open.

design.risk: CAUTION: diagnostic observation and cross-backend GPU comparison; production arithmetic unchanged
design.reason: MLX alone could not distinguish a shared port defect from quiet saved codes.
design.input_contract: Exactly the same complete ten codebooks in all arms, main token excluded; no truncation, clipping, resampling, normalization or regenerated sampler stream.
design.original_loader: Original direct DAC CLI F32 semantics, strict independent state keys/shapes and assign=True; 535 F32 parameters, preserved parametrized weight norm, three constructed BF16 RoPE buffers and three boolean masks.
design.precision_scope: Original BF16 serving-loader/full text generation path not tested. Original model reference precision is not overridden.
design.gpu_boundary: Unobserved and observed Fish from_indices both run on MPS with CPU fallback0 and scoped device/scalar guards. All comparisons and waveform-window reductions run on GPU. No mid-decode activation/scalar reads. Existing native control reads/drains retained.
design.serialization_boundary: Weights/input codes and completed cross-process fixtures transfer once before computation; reference activation export and final diagnostics/WAV serialization occur after completed decoding.
design.strongest_failure_guard: Original observer must exactly reproduce separate unobserved full decode, plus negative GPU guard tests, identical full-code checks, pinned source/checkpoint/layout/hash checks, reducer corruption oracle and unchanged native regression.

mlx_reference.device: Apple M2 Max, 64 GiB unified memory

runtime.note: MLX fixtures use old reference environment MLX/MLX-Metal0.31.1. Inherited MLX0.30.0 packages in the separate Fish venv were not used for these original Fish decodes.
runtime.installed_package_source_scope: All15 installed DAC Python source hashes retained; package version1.0.0 enforced. No comparison with Fish lockfile distribution hash is claimed.

native_rope_path.fact: The resident decoder does not request freqs_cis from WeightStore; it dispatches RoPE with row/head/dimension/base parameters, and the Metal kernel recomputes frequency, angle, cos, and sin for each position in F32.

rope_cache_binding.scope: static serialized tensor bytes and source-level binding only; does not test activation values or prove the source of postlayer0 drift

source_override_chain.fact: from_pretrained builds the module, mx.load reads codec.safetensors, sanitize keeps freqs_cis keys, then passes all weights to dac.load_weights
Module.__setattr__ stores mx.array attributes in the module tree; load_weights updates the provided tree; update replaces an existing mx.array field with the supplied array
Transformer constructor first creates freqs_cis with dtype=mx.float32; the checkpoint load above replaces it when the same key is present

rope_cache_binding.effective_mlx_runtime_cache_binding: MLX: The F32 constructor cache is overridden by all three serialized cache arrays. The converted F32 values are exactly the original BF16 values expanded to F32, so runtime cache dtype is F32 but its values retain BF16 rounding.
rope_cache_binding.fish_direct_loader_buffer_binding: Fish direct DAC keeps its constructed BF16 nonpersistent RoPE buffers. The strict reference loader filters serialized nonpersistent names; those checkpoint cache keys do not overwrite these constructed buffers.

weight_identity_and_rope_audit.scope: CPU serialized bytes/source only, no model inference. Native recomputation versus BF16-derived loaded RoPE is a path difference, not established drift or silence causality.

full_gate_contract: All intermediate-stage gates AND waveform-pointwise gate AND finite one-PCM16-LSB gate AND both waveform peaks>1e-7. Exit0 reports a valid measurement and does not mean parity.

quiet_region.scope: Terminal GPU signal statistics, not a transcript or audibility threshold.

interpretation.supported: Original Fish and both ports preserve the measured quiet tails on the same full codes. A decoder-port-only cause is insufficient for these inputs.
interpretation.not_supported: No unique generation/prompt/sampler/checkpoint cause, transcript, original Fish text-generation parity, strict native DAC parity or speedup.
interpretation.numerical_frontier: Fish/MLX full gates fail427 and768 despite all waveform/PCM gates passing. Native first failed boundary is postlayer0 in all4. Loaded versus recomputed RoPE is a controlled next probe, not a cause claim.
interpretation.timing: Diagnostic retention/reductions/fixture I/O are included; times are not comparable inference benchmarks.
